Subject: Northstar expansion: 6 new apps / license amendment request

Hi Karthik,

Thanks for the catch-up last week. We're ready to move forward with adding six new internal apps (two new teams) that will hit Redwood through the same account. High level: we expect the additional footprint to be ~1.5B tokens/month on top of our existing commit, and we need separate API keys per app (12 keys total — dev + prod per app).

Key asks:
- Can you provision 12 new prod/dev key pairs under our tenant namespace?
- What does the pricing look like for the incremental usage and is there a preferred amendment path to fold this into our current renewal rather than a separate contract?
- We need the new keys live by June 1 to align with our sprint.

I'm attaching an updated app list and initial traffic estimates. Procurement is on copy for the licensing/PO side. If there's anything you need from engineering (expected QPS, IP allowlist), let me know and I'll get it over.

Attachments: Northstar_AppList_v2.xlsx (spreadsheet)

Thanks,
Elena Ruiz
Head of Platform
Northstar Labs

From: karthik_iyer@redwood.ai

Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 11 May 2027 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Northstar expansion: 6 new apps / license amendment request

Elena —

Appreciate the clear ask and the timeline. Short answer: yes, we can do the key provisioning and fold the capacity into an amendment to your existing agreement. Suggested next steps (mutual action plan):

1) We (Redwood) will draft an amendment that adds the 6 apps + adjusted token commit and updated unit pricing (we can extend current discounts on incremental usage since you're adding meaningful scale). Target: draft SOW to you by EOD Thu, May 13.

2) CS (Laura, cc'd) to own rollout plan and key provisioning schedule. Laura — can you propose a key naming convention, canary activation plan, and smoke-test window?

3) Procurement: once SOW is finalized, we can attach to the master agreement and issue a consolidated invoice or a short addendum PO depending on procurement preference. Marissa will help on pricing and billing path.

Prelim pricing note: ballpark incremental cost (post-discount) looks like ~$0.0008/token for the incremental tier given the 1.5B delta; final number will be in the SOW. If you want hard numbers earlier I can put a provisional quote together.

On timing: provisioning 12 key pairs and basic namespace config is a 3–5 business day ops task once we have final app list and IP ranges (if you need IP allowlisting).

I'll create a short checklist and attach a draft SOW (v3) for your review.

Thanks — looping in Ben for capacity planning and Marissa for commercial.

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Account Executive, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Elena Ruiz <elena@northstar.io>, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 12 May 2027 14:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Northstar expansion: rollout plan and key provisioning details

Hi Elena / team —

Thanks for the details, Elena. Below is a recommended rollout and operational checklist specifically tuned to minimize risk given the scale increase:

- Key strategy and naming: namespace = northstar-prod / northstar-dev; keys per app: {app-name}-dev-key / {app-name}-prod-key. We'll create the prod keys with stricter rate limits until canary completes.
- Provisioning timeline:
  * Day 0 (on acceptance): create dev keys for all 6 apps and add to staging tenant.
  * Day 2: run automated smoke tests (token burn <0.5% of expected traffic) and validate response-times and KV caching behavior.
  * Day 4: create prod keys and stage for canary rollout (10% traffic for 48h).
  * Day 7: full traffic ramp if canary passes.
- Monitoring: we'll enable per-key dashboards in Redwood Console with token-level cost, latency p50/p99, and prompt divergence alerts tied to your eval set. We'll also add automatic fallback policies to route traffic to an existing compatible model variant in case of capacity constraints.
- Quotas & rate-limits: recommend soft token quotas per app initially (set at 110% of your forecast) plus hard per-second QPS caps to protect downstream systems. Please provide expected peak QPS per app.
- Security: if you need IP allowlisting, send us the ranges; for stricter controls we can do VPC peering for select workloads but that extends timeline by ~2–3 weeks.

I'll own the provisioning once we have the final app list and the PO/SOW is accepted. I can also run a smoke test with your engineering contact on Thursday, May 27 — please confirm an engineer for that slot.

Attaching: Redwood_onboarding-checklist.pdf for your internal runbook. I'll also upload the SOW draft to the shared folder referenced below.

Laura Bennett
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.ai
